::: {.hero}
# David Hummels

[Distinguished Professor of Economics and Marshall and Susan Larsen Chair, Purdue University · Dean Emeritus, Daniels School of Business · Research Associate, NBER]{.lead}

My research focuses on international trade, including offshoring and its effects on labor markets, product differentiation, trade barriers, and the role of aviation and infrastructure in trade. I have also worked on executive compensation, worker health and labor markets, and, increasingly, the economics of higher education. I teach international economics and growth and innovation, and co-write *Finding Equilibrium*, a weekly Substack on the future of higher education.

[CV](https://webapps.krannert.purdue.edu/sites/Home/Files/User/e0325fe9-c425-4525-b652-c3a20929c581/DownloadCv) · [NBER](https://www.nber.org/people/David_Hummels) · [Purdue profile](https://business.purdue.edu/faculty/hummelsd/home.php) · [Substack](https://findingequilibriumfuturehighered.substack.com/) · <hummelsd@purdue.edu>
:::
